port_decisions: Retain Ocarina Reborn UI, diagnostics, FSR 3.1.6 integration, graphics options, capture pooling and upload batching.
Keep asynchronous render-thread Auto disabled while known GPU-written-table ordering limitations remain. Explicit testing overrides remain.
Keep explicit user texture-memory limits in addition to the shared hardware budget.
Invalidate shader caches when the translator changes; do not forge a compatible stamp.
Use the shipped renderer PGO profile with compatibility checks and an unprofiled fallback.
Private runtime targets Pascal's CPU; public distribution must continue to build game code on each user's own PC.
